I wrote `component.html` in the folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is untested.

It follows `DESIGN.md` and uses values from `tokens.css`, copied inline so the file is self-contained. The page sits on white in a single 1120px column. "REQUESTS" is in Unbounded Light capitals. The message block is centered, with the title in Unbounded Medium and the line in muted body text. "Create a Request" is the ink pill button. "Import from a spreadsheet" is a plain accent-colored link, not a button.

- **One primary button:** `DESIGN.md` allows one primary button per screen, and also puts the screen's main action at the top right. Your content lists the button once, inside the message. I put it there and left the top row as the heading only.
- **No fonts bundled:** The folder has no font files, so Unbounded and Archivo fall back to the system sans-serif unless they're installed locally.
